newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One shares tumble after rumours.
newsitem.headline: Finance One shares tumble after rumours.

text.p: Shares of largest Thai finance firm, Finance One, dropped in late trade on Friday after rumours, denied by the company, about a possible run on its deposits and that it faced a liquidity crunch, brokers said.
At 0742 GMT, Finance One had fallen its 10 percent daily limit down and was off 2.50 at 23 baht. The share was the most actively traded on the market.
"There was a talk that major depositors of Finance One had made large withdrawals and this might have caused a severe liquidity crunch," a broker at a local house said.
Rumours that some Finance One subsidiaries or affiliates also faced financial problems also triggered worries about Finance One's health, brokers said.
Earlier, Ekkapat Finance and Securities, in which Finance One's investment arm One Holdings Plc is a major shareholder, also denied rumours that it faced liquidity problems.
Ekkapat shares were untraded on Friday after closing at 12.75 baht on Thursday.
